notes.title: Patch Notes v2.1.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26308707/e4d9fbd6420ef8cf74b00f2804a9f4a6b5933c70.jpg

Dear Friends,

here are the patch notes for v2.1.2 of Along the Edge:
— Dual Sense Gamepad support. Your PlayStation 5 gamepads should now work correctly both via USB and Bluetooth.
— Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor was disabled when playing on a touchscreen equipped Windows device.

Please note that our Twitch integration beta has been disabled. Unfortunately, Twitch completely changed its token system, rendering the feature unusable for the time being. 

If you're interested in Twitch integration, please reach out to us, we will consider devoting some of humble resources to make it work again if there's enough demand.

Edit / Hotfix 12/15/2023 :
— Fixed a potentially progress breaking bug that could occur in Chapter 5 (December), [spoiler]when Daphné and Sophie enter the tower[/spoiler].

Thank you and kind regards,

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Patch Notes (v2.1.0) — Ready for the Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26308707/16569adca877bca56a3f02b2f3a2c05299dcddc9.jpg

Hello everyone!

We're very glad to announce that Along the Edge is now ready for the Steam Deck!

 Various bug fixes.

Cheers!

on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Patch Notes (v2.0.0) — Switching to Unity
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26308707/c0a447fce15b9269a41ac30c9cfb69db012f493c.jpg

Hello Everyone!

We just released v2.0.0 of Along the Edge which is a big milestone for the game. 

Here are the patch notes:

Unity engine integration: better performances, optimisation, and stability,
Better gamepad support,
Discord "rich presence" integration,
Option UI: changed from sound "on/off" to volume "0 to 10",
New German fan translation (big thanks to Kim Hellal for her incredible work!),
New English translation (extensive proofreading by our usual translator, Rachel Capie),
UI redesign,
New "Log" feature (replaces the old "Replay" feature),
New game introduction and tutorials,
Music and SFX remaster (FMOD integration),
New SFX on choices and gamepad vibrations integration,
New crossfade transitions between scenes,
Various bug fixes, 
Various typo fixes.


My save has disappeared, what should I do?

This engine upgrade brings a lot of improvements and new features, but unfortunately, while the unlocked achievements are kept, saves are not compatible between the old and the new version of the game.

However, if you're in the midst of the story and want to finish it with your old save file it's still possible, don't worry!

In order to restore the older (electron-based) version of the game :

    Go to your Steam Library,
    Right-click on the name of the game in the list, then choose “properties”, 
    Navigate to the “betas” tab, 
    Choose "Electron" in the drop-down list,
    Steam should then restore the older version of the game.
 

If you want to go back to the newer version, do the same process and choose "NONE - opt out of all beta programs" in the drop-down list.

We'll keep the old electron-based version available for as long as we reasonably can, but please be aware that we won't be issuing any patch or support on the electron version in the future. All new patches and upgrades will be done on the unity version. We encourage you to switch as soon as you can to enjoy the best experience.

Please note that the achievements synchronize between the two versions: any achievement you've already unlocked will remain unlocked in the new version.

If you have any question, don't hesitate to reach out, we'll monitor the Steam forums and do our best to provide our support if anything goes wrong during the transition.

Cheers!

Geoffroy,
on behalf of the team.

notes.title: Seers Isle Release
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/0321ef211b32ea1c10cdbecf7b0827590d5dcaf1.jpg

Celtic Western-ish visual novel "Seers Isle" has been released. 

Help young shamans overcome the trials of their initiatory journey in narrative game Seers Isle.

Were are happy to release our new narrative game Seers Isle for Windows, Mac and Linux!

Throughout your adventures in the game Seers Isle, your choices impact the fate of a group of characters.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/a72c94301b3e3ebba6ef19fd0bedee30bddb8a68.jpg

Dreams, fantasy, magic and shamanism are central to every decision: your choices will influence the various story paths and endings, depending on your favorites characters, for a high replayability of the game. More than 600 illustrations have been drawn for the game, in a splendid graphic style inspired by the European Franco-Belge comics.

A group of shaman apprentices land on the shores of a sacred island to be initiated to magic. As they progress through the wilderness, looking for the “Seers”, their spirit-guides, they realize they’re not alone. Who is this strange horned woman they are seeing in their dreams? 

A story full of the magical spirit of Northern European myth.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018731/04847dd176ecd2e854f3994345364c43e7fdec62.jpg

“The island… It was my prison.
For ages, I roamed the land, helpless,
looking for a way out...
And then, they arrived.”

Seers Isle is avalaible now on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/738650/Seers_Isle/

You can also get the game + the soundtrack at a special price (26% off):

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8183/Game__Soundtrack/

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.5.0) — Gamepad support!
notes.notes:
Along the Edge v1.5.0 is now live for everyone!

The game is now fully compatible with Xbox and Steam controllers.

Full patch notes :
- engine improvements for better performance (animations, texts loading, assets management),
- the game is now fully compatible with game-pads (Xbox controllers, Steam controller),
- added a "fast skip" feature: long press on "space" on keyboard or the "A" button on game-pad now quickly skips texts and dialog (thanks for everyone who suggested it),
- launching a save in the "game over" state now shows you the achievements you've unlocked during your play-through instead of bringing you back to the main menu,
- fixed several minor bugs and glitches.

Enjoy,

Geoffroy.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.5.0 Beta)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

we've just released the version 1.5.0 of Along the Edge in the beta channel.

We've rebuilt a lot of stuff under the hood to improve performance and added new features to address some quality of life issues.

Here are the patch notes:
- engine improvements for better performance (animations, texts loading, assets management),
- the game is now fully compatible with game-pads (Xbox controllers, Steam controller),
- added a "fast skip" feature: long press on "space" on keyboard or the "A" button on game-pad now quickly skips texts and dialog (thanks for everyone who suggested it),
- launching a save in the "game over" state now shows you the achievements you've unlocked during your play-through instead of bringing you back to the main menu,
- fixed several minor bugs and glitches.

Since we've changed so much things on the engine side, we feel like it's safer to let the update for a couple of weeks in beta before releasing it for everyone.
In theory, everything should work without any hiccups. 
The team would like to thank anyone who may want to opt-in for testing the release. If you find any bug, we would really appreciate if you contact us either via the form on alongtheedge-game.com/contact or here, in the Steam Forums.

How to opt-in for the beta:
- go to your Steam Library,
- right-click on "Along the Edge" in the list of game on the left and choose "Properties",
- click on the "BETA" tab on the top of the pop-up window that appeared,
- select "beta - Beta Branch" in the drop-down menu (no password is required),
- the game should start updating immediately.

To opt-out and go back to the release branch, go back to the "BETA" tab in properties and choose "NONE - opt out of all beta programs".

Thanks,

Geoffroy.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.3.4)
notes.notes:
We have a few quality of life improvements to announce for this patch :
- added full keyboard support (in-game). Press “up” / “down” or “left” / “right” directional arrow keys to select a choice, and “enter” to validate it. “space” is still used to skip texts,
- Daphné’s name now appear in light yellow when she talks,
- added a “large text” functionality for visually impaired readers (go to Title Screen > Options to enable it),
- fixed “escape” key not showing properly the pause menu while in-game,
- fixed a minor typo in French.

Special thanks to Raton-Laveur for suggesting a better keyboard support.

And as always, we would like to thank everyone for your kindness and support!

Geoffroy.

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.3.1)
notes.notes:
First of all, on behalf of the whole team, I'd like to extend a big "thank you" for the warm welcome we received here, from the Steam Community!

Your nice words and comments mean a lot to the team.

We have updated the game to version 1.3.1, here is what we have fixed:
- updated English and French translation,
- corrected a bug preventing “Sound in Mind” achievement from unlocking correctly,
- fixed a story inconstancy in Chapter 4,
- unlocked achievements now synchronize with Steam when you launch the game.

Edit (10/25/2016): Achievement "Sound in Mind" should now unlock correctly on every system. Thank you for your patience!

Special thanks to  Alexandra, Leondre and Sharisad for reporting several typos, and to Ahil, Epilexia, Hendumaica and Soulless_Drake for taking the time to explain the bugs they encountered. 

Yours,

Geoffroy.

PS: We just released a set of Steam Trading Cards for Along the Edge. Enjoy!
